title: Structure is Supervision: Multiview Masked Autoencoders for Radiology
abstract: arXiv:2511.22294v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Building robust medical machine learning systems requires pretraining strategies that exploit the intrinsic structure present in clinical data. We introduce Multiview Masked Autoencoder (MVMAE), a self-supervised framework that leverages the natural multi-view organization of radiology studies to learn view-invariant and disease-relevant representations. MVMAE combines masked image reconstruction with cross-view alignment, transforming clinical redundancy across projections into a powerful self-supervisory signal. We further extend this approach with MVMAE-V2T, which incorporates radiology reports as an auxiliary text-based learning signal to enhance semantic grounding while preserving fully vision-based inference. Evaluated on a downstream disease classification task on three large-scale public datasets, MIMIC-CXR, CheXpert, and PadChest, MVMAE consistently outperforms supervised and vision-language baselines. translated_title: 结构即监督：面向放射学的多视角掩码自编码器
translated_abstract: 构建稳健的医学机器学习系统需要能够利用临床数据中内在结构的预训练策略。我们提出了多视角掩码自编码器（MVMAE），这是一个自监督框架，它利用放射学检查中自然存在的多视角组织结构，来学习视角不变且与疾病相关的表征。MVMAE 将掩码图像重建与跨视角对齐相结合，把不同投影视角之间的临床冗余转化为强大的自监督信号。我们进一步将该方法扩展为 MVMAE-V2T，它将放射学报告作为辅助的基于文本的学习信号，以增强语义基础，同时保持完全基于视觉的推理。在三个大规模公开数据集（MIMIC-CXR、CheXpert 和 PadChest）上的下游疾病分类任务评估中，MVMAE 持续优于有监督基线和视觉-语言基线。此外，MVM…（摘要内容不完整，在此截断）
tldr: 提出多视角掩码自编码器 MVMAE 及其结合放射学报告的扩展版 MVMAE-V2T，利用放射影像天然的多视角结构作为自监督信号，在三个大规模数据集的疾病分类任务上持续超越有监督和视觉-语言基线方法。
en_tdlr: MVMAE and its extension MVMAE-V2T exploit the natural multi-view structure of radiology studies (with radiology reports as an auxiliary text signal) as self-supervision, consistently outperforming supervised and vision-language baselines on disease classification across three large-scale datasets.
